Definition: Elam, a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elam = "eternity"; n pr m; 1) a Korhite Levite in the time of David; 2) a chief man of the tribe of Benjamin; 3) ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel; 4) a chief of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 5) another ancestor of another family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel; 6) a priest who assisted at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 7) another head of a family of returning exiles; n pr loc; 8) a province east of Babylon and northeast of the lower Tigris
